item.title: Tesla’s ‘Full Self-Driving’ Becomes ‘Assisted Driving’ in Europe
item.description: The automaker has been criticized for misleading drivers with the feature’s name. Now it’s renaming it for European regulators.

item.title: The RAMpocalypse has led global PC shipments to drop 20 percent in just 12 months
item.description: PC sales are down 20-21% year-over-year and 9% in a quarter – and prices aren't really going to get any better.

item.title: An Anthropic model submitted a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: Thankfully, it does not seem to have diverted police resources.

item.title: An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
item.description: Anthropic did not discover this behavior until over two months after its AI submitted the false tip.

item.title: Book Publishers Are Quietly Using More AI. Staff Are Revolting
item.description: Workers at three major publishing houses tell WIRED that LLMs are being used for publicity, cover art, back cover copy, and emails, as some execs push junior staff to champion the tech.

item.title: MSI Pro Max Edge AI+ mini PC review
item.description: The MSI Pro Max Edge AI+ is a mini PC with a difference. Built for local AI, it features the AMD’s Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060s graphics and a 50-TOPS NPU.

item.title: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops start at $2,599 — pre-orders are live now
item.description: Pre-orders are now live for Nvidia RTX Spark laptops, but these are the three Blackwell-powered machines I'd buy if you're a small business running local AI.

item.title: Anker Soundcore AeroClip 2 review: a solid pair of ultra-compact, featherweight clip-on earbuds
item.description: Anker’s new clip-on earbuds effortlessly blend a stylish aesthetic with hi-tech features — and they don’t sound half bad, either.

item.title: How to watch Boston Blue season 2 online for free – stream police drama from anywhere
item.description: Here's how to watch Boston Blue season 2 online no matter where in the world you are.

item.title: Bill Murray says Rivian’s Ghostbusters Ecto-R1 is “perfect” — and I’ve seen it in action
item.description: Rivian is bringing Ghostbusters to its electric vehicles with a Halloween software update, and I got to see Bill Murray with the custom Ecto-R1 in New York City and try the new features for myself.

item.title: Suit says dynamic AI prices at McDonald’s are ‘nickel-and-diming consumers’
item.description: An antitrust lawsuit is being brought against McDonald’s alleging the chain is using dynamic AI pricing to rip off customers.

item.title: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines used at many data centers
item.description: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines as the data center boom pushes prices up.
